mapper.insert: INSERT INTO derive_stage_run (run_id, stage, status, attempt) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stage}, 'PENDING', #{attempt}) ON CONFLICT (run_id, stage, attempt) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, stage, status, attempt, lease_owner, lease_until, error_code, error_path, message, output_revision, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_stage_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND stage = #{stage} ORDER BY attempt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, stage, status, attempt, lease_owner, lease_until, error_code, error_path, message, output_revision, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_stage_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > NOW())) ORDER BY id

SELECT id, run_id, stage, status, attempt, lease_owner, lease_until, error_code, error_path, message, output_revision, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_stage_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY stage, attempt DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE derive_stage_run SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, error_code = NULL, error_path = NULL, message = NULL, updated_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND stage = #{stage} AND attempt = #{attempt} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= NOW()))

UPDATE derive_stage_run SET status = #{state}, error_code = #{code}, error_path = #{path}, message = #{message}, output_revision = #{outputRevision,jdbcType=INTEGER}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}
UPDATE derive_stage_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED')
